item.title: Norwalk Girls Basketball Ends 2025 with their First Loss, Boys Win their 4th Straight
item.description: Both Norwalk basketball teams finished out 2025 play on Saturday in separate non-conference matchups. The girls team fell to Maquoketa 76-71 at the Johnston Winter Tip-Off Classic, while the boys won a home contest against Valley 58-54.
